Initial release of Driver Receipt Generator.

- Instantly create and send professional receipts for rideshare, taxi, limo, and delivery drivers.
- Collects all essential ride details and supports various ride types (standard, airport transfer, summaries).
- Integrates with ReceAI for easy receipt creation, sharing, and email.
- Includes templates for individual rides and monthly income summaries.
- Designed to support both cash and electronic payments, with options for custom logos and record management.
